notes.title: The drawing function has added gradient color filling.
notes.notes: The drawing feature has added linear gradient and radial color gradient functions, and optimized the color of the graphic templates.

notes.title: Rhythm custom gameplay adds the ability to read MP4
notes.notes: The custom reading function in Rhythm Play can directly read MP4 type files and play the MP4 content as the game background.

notes.title: Added match-3 gameplay
notes.notes:
Add match-3 gameplay to the game
1.The classic three-elimination gameplay has three modes: single-player mode, two-player co-op and two-player competition.
2.There are more than 30 levels by default.
3.Built-in level editing function to freely modify, export and import configurations.

notes.title: Fixed a bug with the rhythm game prompt
notes.notes: Fixed an issue where Rhythm Games would incorrectly click on a non-default number of tracks
